extraction_notes: Only SI data were extracted. Literature rows in SI Table S1 marked with reference numbers [6]–[10] were excluded. SI Tables S2, S4, and S5 are structural/DFT data and were excluded; SI Table S3 reports kinetic orders/activation energies but no individual NH3 synthesis rates, outlet NH3 concentrations, or TOFs. SI Figure S16 was treated as kinetic-model fitting/derived plot and skipped because the underlying distinct feed compositions/conditions for the experimental-rate points are not reported in the SI figure.
